title: New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact
issuing_body: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) / India AI Impact Summit (AI Summit series)

timeline.event: India announced as host of the next AI summit at the Paris AI Action Summit
India AI Impact Summit opens at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi
Prime Minister inaugurates leaders' segment
Summit concludes; New Delhi Declaration adopted with 85-88 endorsements including the US and China
Three more countries join; PIB reports 91 signatories
Bangladesh reported as 89th country signatory
Switzerland confirmed as host of next summit in Geneva, June 2027; UAE to host 2028

summary: Non-binding outcome declaration of the fourth AI summit in the Bletchley-Seoul-Paris series, hosted by India. It organises commitments around seven thematic 'chakras' on access to AI resources, trusted AI, science, skilling and energy-efficient AI.
key_provisions: Endorsed by 85-88 countries and organisations at adoption on 21 Feb 2026 and 91 by 24 Feb 2026, including both the United States and China; later counts (89 countries by May 2026) use a different base

Seven pillars: democratising AI resources; growth and social good via a 'Global AI Impact Commons'; secure and trusted AI via a 'Trusted AI Commons'; an International Network of AI for Science Institutions; social empowerment; human capital; resilience and energy efficiency
Frames AI governance around 'impact' and inclusion rather than frontier risk; contains no verification or reporting mechanism

Summit-linked pledges: IndiaAI compute to grow from 38,000 GPUs by a further 20,000; private investment pledges reported at over USD 200-250 billion (Reliance USD 110bn, Adani USD 100bn, Google USD 15bn Visakhapatnam hub)
Follow-on summits: Geneva, June 2027 (Switzerland) and UAE, 2028
confidence_note: PIB press releases of 21 and 24 Feb 2026 confirmed by headline only (PIB release pages and impact.indiaai.gov.in could not be fetched); content of the seven pillars taken from Drishti IAS, ORF and IAPP summaries. Signatory counts conflict across sources (85/86/88/91/89). Official declaration URL not located; PIB home page given as placeholder.
